<<<POU name=AlarmHyst kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK AlarmHyst
VAR_INPUT
    Value : REAL;
    hiLevel : REAL;
    loLevel : REAL;
    hystWindow : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    hiAlarm : BOOL;
    loAlarm : BOOL;
    error : BOOL;
    status : WORD;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
error := FALSE;
status := 0;
IF loLevel >= hiLevel THEN
    error := TRUE;
    status := 16#8001;
    hiAlarm := FALSE;
    loAlarm := FALSE;
    RETURN;
END_IF
IF hystWindow >= (hiLevel - loLevel) THEN
    error := TRUE;
    status := 16#8002;
    hiAlarm := FALSE;
    loAlarm := FALSE;
    RETURN;
END_IF
IF Value > hiLevel THEN
    hiAlarm := TRUE;
ELSIF Value < (hiLevel - hystWindow) THEN
    hiAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF
IF Value < loLevel THEN
    loAlarm := TRUE;
ELSIF Value > (loLevel + hystWindow) THEN
    loAlarm := FALSE;
END_IF
<<<END>>>
